records.title: Veloce positioning
records.content: Veloce AgenticOS is a governed AI operating system for turning context, research, decisions, workflows, creative production, and delivery into one controlled operating loop. It combines tenant memory, multiple AI providers, workflow orchestration, approval gates, artifacts, auditability, and lead capture without copying an operator's private laptop environment into the cloud. Tags #veloce #positioning #content

records.title: Ideal customer profile
records.content: Primary audience is an AI or product team coordinating research, decisions, agents, content, delivery, and approvals across several tools. Strong signals include provider sprawl, unclear ownership, repeated context loss, unreviewed automation, and a need for tenant isolation. Tags #veloce #icp #gtm

records.title: Core customer problems
records.content: The campaign should address fragmented AI tools, context that disappears between tasks, unclear human approval points, weak audit trails, unsafe external delivery, duplicated research, and difficulty proving which model or workflow produced an outcome. Tags #veloce #icp #content

records.title: Veloce capabilities
records.content: Proven hosted capabilities include tenant-scoped authentication, tenant records, Markdown memory import and export, explicit tag-based knowledge graphs, multiple allowlisted provider adapters, deterministic workflow orchestration, approval-oriented plans, artifacts, delivery controls, audit records, budgets, monitoring, and public lead capture. Tags #veloce #proof

records.title: Proof and current limitations
records.content: Proof must distinguish verified hosted behavior from future integrations. Current hosted proof includes tenant isolation, records, workflows, reviewed plans, approved provider calls, test delivery controls, and lead capture. Current limitations include no local Ollama execution, no Obsidian filesystem access, no full Graphify semantic extraction, no automatic social publishing, no live prospect discovery without an approved adapter, and no Codex access without separate API billing. Tags #veloce #proof #governance

records.title: Objections and responses
records.content: Objection: Is this just a chat wrapper? Response: The product is organized around context, ownership, review, workflow state, artifacts, delivery, and audit evidence. Objection: Is it a copy of a laptop setup? Response: No; the hosted edition deliberately uses tenant-scoped replacements and makes its boundaries explicit. Objection: Does automation publish without approval? Response: This campaign uses drafts and test delivery only. Tags #veloce #content #governance

records.title: Brand voice
records.content: Use precise, ambitious, calm language. Lead with the operational problem, show the loop, name the proof, and state limitations without hiding them. Avoid inflated claims such as fully autonomous, perfect parity, or zero oversight. Tags #veloce #content #governance

records.title: Offer and CTA
records.content: Offer an owner-guided product walkthrough for AI and product teams. CTA: Want to see how a governed AI operating loop could work for your team? Start here: https://product-experience-five.vercel.app/start. Tags #veloce #gtm #content

records.title: Campaign governance rules
records.content: Drafts and test delivery only. Human approval is required before publication, outreach, or consequential delivery. Use allowlisted providers and models within the owner-cloud budget. Never place credentials or private operator data in prompts or tenant records. Claims must separate proven hosted features from future integrations. Tags #veloce #governance

records.title: Campaign success metrics
records.content: Measure completion of the guided acceptance loop, provider smoke outcomes, tenant record and workflow evidence, quality of the campaign assets, successful test delivery, distinguishable public lead capture from both forms, email receipt, qualified replies, and documented intentional gates. No public publishing is a success criterion for this first run. Tags #veloce #gtm #proof

workflows.title: Veloce AI product-team launch campaign
workflows.goal: Produce a reviewed campaign that explains Veloce, demonstrates its governed AI workflow, generates qualified interest, and routes prospects to the public intake form. Stages: research audience pain; define product narrative; draft launch content; create a one-minute explanation; prepare SEO topics; prepare lead magnet; review claims and privacy boundaries; approve drafts; test delivery; measure responses. Human approval is required before external publication or outreach.

workflows.title: Veloce campaign paperclip workstream
workflows.goal: Map campaign assets to bounded work items, owners, dependencies, review gates, and reversible handoffs. Capture the result as tenant workflow evidence; do not publish externally.

workflows.title: Veloce campaign coordination room
workflows.goal: Coordinate research, narrative, content, SEO, lead capture, and delivery review as separate workstreams with a final human approval checkpoint.

workflows.title: Veloce campaign pipeline
workflows.goal: Move the internal campaign from brief to reviewed draft to test delivery while recording owner, priority, evidence, and blocked provider gates.

workflows.title: Veloce campaign agent kanban
workflows.goal: Create bounded campaign work items for narrative, short-form video, SEO, lead magnet, FAQ, and evidence collection with approval required before delivery.

workflows.title: Veloce campaign review board
workflows.goal: Track each campaign asset through draft, evidence review, claim review, approval, test delivery, and measurement.

workflows.title: Veloce campaign learning loop
workflows.goal: Use audience response, provider results, lead capture evidence, and review findings to decide the next bounded campaign iteration.

workflows.title: Veloce campaign multi-agent handoff
workflows.goal: Define a reviewed multi-agent handoff for research, copy, SEO, governance, and evidence without enabling autonomous external actions.

briefs.title: Veloce master launch brief
briefs.details: Create the governed campaign narrative and asset plan for AI and product teams. Include problem, mechanism, proof, limitations, CTA, review gates, and evidence requirements.

briefs.title: Veloce landing page improvement brief
briefs.details: Draft a clear product landing-page improvement brief showing the governed operating loop, tenant boundary, proof, limitations, and intake CTA.

briefs.title: Veloce public homepage brief
briefs.details: Prepare homepage copy and structure for AI and product teams. Explain the operating loop without claiming full local/cloud parity.

briefs.title: Veloce visitor to lead flow brief
briefs.details: Map the visitor journey from product proof to the public intake form, including source attribution, confirmation, notification, and human follow-up.

briefs.title: Veloce content production brief
briefs.details: Create drafts for a LinkedIn launch post, one-minute reel, three hooks, product explainer outline, lead magnet, FAQ, and objection handling.

briefs.title: Veloce product demonstration video brief
briefs.details: Draft a one-minute product demonstration storyboard showing context, orchestration, review, artifact, delivery, and lead capture. Media generation remains budget and provider gated.

briefs.title: Veloce interactive product demo concept
briefs.details: Design a bounded interactive concept that lets a visitor follow a governed AI operating loop. Keep it demonstrative and do not imply that a live prospect is being acted on.

briefs.title: Veloce campaign thumbnail brief
briefs.details: Prepare thumbnail directions for the product explainer and one-minute reel using a clear governed-loop message and readable mobile-first typography.
